### Walk with God
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/harvest-daily-july-26-2005-1342326.html
Passage: Genesis 5:24
Points:
- Walking in close fellowship and harmony with God is essential for an effective spiritual testimony.
- Enoch pleased God through an everyday life lived in step with Him.
- God spared Enoch physical death by miraculously carrying him directly to heaven.
- Walking faithfully with God on earth prepares believers to walk with Him in eternity.

### Of Enoch and Long Walks
Author: Karen Ehman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-jan-9-2009-11597924.html
Passage: Genesis 5:24
Points:
- Enoch stands out in Scripture because he walked with God and pleased Him.
- Pleasing God is conceptually simple, but our flesh and desire for control complicate it.
- Walking with God requires surrendering personal navigation instead of running ahead with our own plans.
- Intimate, day-by-day faith fosters continuous closeness to the Lord throughout life.
